candidates.name: Pole of Freedoms – Pole of Good Government

elections.notes: The Senate used a single vote per candidate, counted by coalition or by list running alone (Pole of Freedoms – Pole of Good Government 13,342,940 (40.34%); Alliance of Progressives 10,881,320 (32.90%); Pact for Italy 5,519,090 (16.69%); Pannella List 767,765 (2.32%)), so there is no party vote and votes are null; parties are listed with their own seats. The overall table splits the Pole's seats as Northern League 60, National Alliance 48, Forza Italia 36, Christian Democratic Centre 12, which adds to 156, but its constituency tables give the Pole 128 single-member and 27 proportional seats (155) and the Senate total is 315, so the Pole is shown as one row. Pact for Italy (PPI and Segni Pact) is not split in the table. Seats are elected senators only. Turnout is from the infobox.

The SVP row is the joint list "The Fir – SVP – PATT". Seats are elected senators only. Turnout is from the infobox.

elections.notes: The Senate used a single vote per candidate, counted by coalition or by list running alone (House of Freedoms 14,406,519 (42.57%); The Olive Tree 13,282,495 (39.22%); Communist Refoundation Party 1,708,707 (5.04%); European Democracy 1,066,908 (3.15%); Italy of Values 1,140,489 (3.37%); Bonino List 677,725 (2.00%); Tricolour Flame 340,221 (1.00%)), so there is no party vote and votes are null; parties are listed with their own seats.
